definitions.explanation: Fitting or right for a particular situation, purpose, or context. Implies a well-considered choice that is neither too much nor too little.

examples.japanese: {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{適切|てきせつ}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Making an appropriate judgment for the situation is required.

examples.japanese: {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{適切|てきせつ}な⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ければ→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: If you receive proper treatment at the right time, the chances of recovery are high.

notes:
A formal and versatile na-adjective used across many contexts — business, medicine, education, law, and daily life. It implies that the choice or action is well-matched to the situation at hand. Often used in written language and formal speech.

The adverbial form {適切|てきせつ}に (appropriately) is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧: appropriate response
- {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧: proper judgment
- {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: appropriate expression
- {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{処置|しょち}→処置：05823_shochi⟧: proper treatment/measures
- {適切|てきせつ}な⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: the right time
- {適切|てきせつ}に⟦{対処|たいしょ}する→対処する：20049_taishosuru⟧: to deal with appropriately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧な: suitable; appropriate — can also mean "random" or "half-hearted" in colloquial use, making it ambiguous
- ⟦{妥当|だとう}→妥当：04053_datou⟧な: reasonable; valid — emphasizes logical soundness rather than fitness for purpose
- {相応|そうおう}しい: befitting; worthy of — emphasizes matching in status or level
- ⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧な: precise; accurate — emphasizes hitting the mark exactly
